tools.name: install_tool
tools.description: Check/install allowlisted packages via pip (playwright, pyautogui, mss, pillow, pytesseract, pynput, beautifulsoup4, lxml). dry_run=true only reports would_install. Playwright can install Chromium. No free apt.

dry_run.description: If true, do not pip install

tools.name: install_tool_check
tools.description: Only check if allowlisted package is importable (never install).

tools.name: install_tool_stack
tools.description: Ensure a stack: all|browser|gui|ocr|scrape. dry_run supported.
